// Stands in for "flutter test --coverage --branch-coverage" in the tests of
// `test_gates test` and `test_gates selfcheck`. Kept as .txt so that it is not
// analyzed or formatted with the package; the tests copy it into a temporary
// directory and run it there.
//
// Usage: dart fake_coverage.dart <mode> <tracefile> [<source file>...]
import 'dart:io';

/// One record per source file, as Dart writes it: an entry for every line on
/// which a function starts. The function of a selfcheck probe is the only one
/// that is "never called".
String measure(List<String> sources, {bool branches = true}) {
  final out = StringBuffer();
  for (final source in sources) {
    out.writeln('SF:$source');
    final lines = File(source).readAsLinesSync();
    for (var index = 0; index < lines.length; index++) {
      final line = lines[index];
      if (line.startsWith('//') || !line.contains('(')) {
        continue;
      }
      final hits = line.contains('testGatesSelfcheckProbe') ? 0 : 1;
      out.writeln('DA:${index + 1},$hits');
      if (branches) {
        out.writeln('BRDA:${index + 1},0,0,$hits');
      }
    }
    out.writeln('end_of_record');
  }
  return out.toString();
}

Future<void> main(List<String> arguments) async {
  final mode = arguments[0];
  final tracefile = File(arguments[1]);
  final sources = arguments.sublist(2);
  void write(String text) => tracefile
    ..createSync(recursive: true)
    ..writeAsStringSync(text);

  switch (mode) {
    case 'honest':
      write(measure(sources));
    case 'no-branches':
      write(measure(sources, branches: false));
    case 'blind':
      // Measures something else than the files on disk: every gate is at
      // 100% whatever is in it.
      write([
        for (final source in sources)
          'SF:$source\nDA:1,1\nBRDA:1,0,0,1\nend_of_record\n',
      ].join());
    case 'truncated':
      final text = measure(sources);
      write(text.substring(0, text.lastIndexOf('end_of_record')));
    case 'failing':
      write(measure(sources));
      stdout.writeln('00:01 +1 -1: Some tests failed.');
      exit(3);
    case 'silent':
      break;
    case 'editing':
      // Somebody saves a gate while the tests run.
      final gate = File(sources.first);
      gate.writeAsStringSync('// edited\n${gate.readAsStringSync()}');
      write(measure(sources));
    case 'overwriting':
      File(sources.first).writeAsStringSync('int replaced() => 2;\n');
      write(measure(sources));
    case 'waiting':
      File('started').writeAsStringSync('$pid');
      await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(minutes: 5));
    default:
      stderr.writeln('unknown mode $mode');
      exit(64);
  }
}
